# 生成物の実例

[English](example-output.md)

`testdata/example` (`example.com/app/main` が `example.com/app/mathx` を import) を build した結果です。

再現: `cd testdata/example && go run ../../cmd/goesm emit-ts ./main` / `go run ../../cmd/goesm build -split ./main`

## 生成 TypeScript (`goesm emit-ts ./main`)

### go/example.com/app/mathx.ts

```ts
// Code generated by goesm from Go package example.com/app/mathx. DO NOT EDIT.
// This TypeScript is an intermediate representation: Go semantics were
// checked by go/types; esbuild only strips types and bundles.
import * as $rt from "@goesm/runtime";
const $t1 = $rt.funcOf([$rt.types.int, $rt.types.int], [$rt.types.int], false);
function Add(a: number, b: number): number {
  return a + b;
}
const $goesm = { path: "example.com/app/mathx", funcs: { Add: { fn: Add, type: $t1, async: false } } };
export { Add, $goesm };
```

### go/example.com/app/main.ts

```ts
// Code generated by goesm from Go package example.com/app/main. DO NOT EDIT.
// This TypeScript is an intermediate representation: Go semantics were
// checked by go/types; esbuild only strips types and bundles.
import * as $rt from "@goesm/runtime";
import "go:example.com/app/mathx";
import * as mathx from "go:example.com/app/mathx";
export * as $runtime from "@goesm/runtime";
const $t1 = $rt.funcOf([], [$rt.types.int], false);
function Result(): number {
  return mathx.Add(1, 2);
}
const $goesm = { path: "example.com/app/main", funcs: { Result: { fn: Result, type: $t1, async: false } } };
export { Result, $goesm };
```

末尾には TS→Go の source map が `//# sourceMappingURL=data:...` として inline で付きます。

## ESM (`goesm build -split ./main`)

### dist/example.com/app/mathx.js

```js
// go/example.com/app/mathx.ts
import * as $rt from "../../@goesm/runtime.js";
var $t1 = $rt.funcOf([$rt.types.int, $rt.types.int], [$rt.types.int], false);
function Add(a, b) {
  return a + b;
}
var $goesm = { path: "example.com/app/mathx", funcs: { Add: { fn: Add, type: $t1, async: false } } };
export {
  $goesm,
  Add
};
//# sourceMappingURL=mathx.js.map
```

### dist/example.com/app/main.js

```js
// go/example.com/app/main.ts
import * as $rt from "../../@goesm/runtime.js";
import "./mathx.js";
import * as mathx from "./mathx.js";
import * as $runtime from "../../@goesm/runtime.js";
var $t1 = $rt.funcOf([], [$rt.types.int], false);
function Result() {
  return mathx.Add(1, 2);
}
var $goesm = { path: "example.com/app/main", funcs: { Result: { fn: Result, type: $t1, async: false } } };
export {
  $goesm,
  $runtime,
  Result
};
//# sourceMappingURL=main.js.map
```

`dist/example.com/app/main.js.map` の `sources` は `mathx.go` / `main.go` を指し、`sourcesContent` に Go source を含みます。

## JavaScript から使う

```js
import { Result } from "./dist/example.com/app/main.js";
Result(); // 3
```

## 意味論の lowering 例 (testdata/semantics より抜粋)

```ts
// pointer: value := 1; Set(&value)
function Set(v: any): void {
  v.v = 10;
}
function PointerExample(): number {
  let value = $rt.cell(1);
  Set(value);
  return value.v;
}

// defer: return 時の値を確定してから defer を実行
function DeferExample(): $rt.S<number> {
  let $r0: $rt.S<number> = null;
  const $d = new $rt.Defers();
  $body: try {
    let result: $rt.S<number> = $rt.sliceLit([]);
    $d.defer((): void => {
      result = $rt.append(result, [3], () => 0);
    });
    result = $rt.append(result, [1], () => 0);
    result = $rt.append(result, [2], () => 0);
    $r0 = result;
    break $body;
  } catch ($e) { $d.fail($e); } finally { $d.run(); }
  return $r0;
}

// map: Go map semantics は runtime の GoMap
function Map(): $rt.S<$rt.Iface | null> {
  let m: $rt.M<string, number> = $rt.mapLit($rt.types.string, [["a", 1]]);
  $rt.mapSet(m, "b", 2);
  const $1 = $rt.mapLookup(m, "a", () => 0);
  let value: number = $1[0];
  let ok: boolean = $1[1];
  const $2 = $rt.mapLookup(m, "zzz", () => 0);
  let missing: number = $2[0];
  let ok2: boolean = $2[1];
  $rt.mapDelete(m, "a");
  const $3 = $rt.mapLookup(m, "a", () => 0);
  $3[0];
  let ok3: boolean = $3[1];
  return $rt.sliceLit([$rt.box($rt.types.int, value), $rt.box($rt.types.bool, ok), $rt.box($rt.types.int, missing), $rt.box($rt.types.bool, ok2), $rt.box($rt.types.bool, ok3), $rt.box($rt.types.int, $rt.mapLen(m)), $rt.box($rt.types.int, $rt.mapGet(m, "b", () => 0))]);
}

// interface: 型 descriptor の method table で dispatch
function Format(v: $rt.Iface | null): string {
  return $rt.icall(v, "String");
}

// goroutine/channel: blocking 関数だけが async
async function Worker(ch: $rt.Chan<number> | null): Promise<void> {
  await $rt.send(ch, 42);
}
async function Example(): Promise<number> {
  let ch: $rt.Chan<number> | null = $rt.makeChan(0, () => 0);
  const $1 = ch;
  $rt.go(async () => { (await Worker($1)); });
  return (await $rt.recv(ch))[0];
}
```
